meta_data.base_class: find the shortest route between two locations based on a specific <travel mode> - different modes share the same start and end inputs but differ in transportation method.

tool_template.name: find_shortest_<class>_path
tool_template.description: Find the shortest path from one location to another using <class> mode of transportation.

start_location.description: The name or coordinates of the start location for the <class> route.

end_location.description: The name or coordinates of the end location for the <class> route.

departure_time.description: Specifies the departure time in 'HH:MM' format for the <class> path calculation.

include_elevation_data.description: If true, includes elevation and slope information for the <class> path.

return_distance.description: Indicates whether to include the total travel distance in the <class> path output.

return_duration.description: Indicates whether to include the estimated travel duration in the <class> path output.
